progress.instructions: How complete is this subagent's task? Read `request` for what it was asked to do and `transcript` for what it has actually done and said. A task that has only been planned is early; one whose work is written but unverified is most of the way; one that has verified its own result is done. Judge the work, not how confident the agent sounds.
criteria: Barely started: it is still exploring or planning and has produced no result
A quarter done: the approach is chosen and the first concrete steps are taken
Half done: substantial work exists but the task is visibly unfinished
Nearly done: the work exists and only verification or cleanup remains
Complete: the requested result exists and has been checked
